name: fishball-taskboard
description: Fishball's own task board and memo pad: tasks with subtasks, status and progress, editable by the user in the right sidebar's Task board tab. Its tools need fishball-core in the same DSH.
//dependencies: fishball-shared carries instance-follower, the one binding to fishballInstance that every Fishball amenity uses (it was board/src/instance.js inside fishball-amenities before the split). It is bundled, as fishball-core bundles it, so the tarball installs with no registry fetch for it.
//dsh: The only Fishball amenity with browser code (client.js, the Task board tab), so the only member with dsh.client.
